a.lede: Legal AI startup Legora announced Wednesday that it raised a $550 million Series E round, valuing it at $8.8 billion.
a.title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation

b.lede: AI assistant startup Town nabbed a unicorn valuation on Monday, announcing a $108 million Series B round co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.
b.title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation 4 months after launch
